units.source_text: 终局次日，我从伊东返回镰仓的家，

en.t: The day after the game ended, I returned from Ito to my home in Kamakura,

units.source_text: 已等不及写完这篇长达六十六天的观战记，

en.t: and, unable to wait until I had finished writing this game report that had lasted sixty-six days,

units.source_text: 仿佛要从这盘棋解脱出来似的，到伊势、京都旅行去了。

en.t: as if trying to free myself from this game of go, I set off on a trip to Ise and Kyoto.
